evals.name: plans-content-migration-without-tenant-writes
evals.description: Verifies that the skill directs callers to plan item migration first and preserves the plugin's dry-run-by-default, injected-executor, confirmation-token write gates.
evals.prompt: Use the migrate-sharepoint-list-content skill to migrate three SharePoint list items into an already-provisioned destination list. Explain the safe sequence and identify what is required before a real write can occur.
expected: States that dry-run is the default
Requires an explicitly injected executor for real writes
Requires the plan-derived confirmation token for real writes
Does not claim that the skill creates lists, fields, content types, or connects to a tenant by itself

evals.name: explains-two-pass-lookup-backfill
evals.description: Verifies that the skill explains lookup-field migration as a two-pass process: migrate content and record source-to-destination IDs, then backfill lookup fields after target items exist.
evals.prompt: Use the migrate-sharepoint-list-content skill for a migration where list items have lookup columns referencing other items migrated in the same run. Describe the required sequencing.
expected: Records source-to-destination ID mappings during the content pass
Resolves lookup source IDs against the mapping only after target items exist
Backfills lookup fields in a second pass
